correctness.rationale: The Leibniz bracket and dual regular representation were reconstructed from the source's multiplication. Both identities of Definition 2.1 were expanded on all four ordered basis pairs. The first rational witness satisfies all fourteen equations printed in Example 2.3 but has true S-defect 2e1; the second has zero defining defect but residual -8 in the source's third printed equation. On the nonzero equal-lower-right branch, direct equations force all four off-diagonal/lower-left entries to -t and, when 2 is invertible, both upper-left entries to t. The packaged checker replays these facts exactly and exhaustively verifies the branch over F3, F5, and F7.

value.rationale: Example 2.3 is the paper's first explicit coordinate calculation for relative Rota-Baxter systems on the dual regular representation, so a wrong outer map compromises the advertised iff equation system rather than a cosmetic intermediate line. The correction is mathematically substantive because the printed system both accepts invalid pairs and rejects valid pairs. The repaired nonzero branch supplies a clean exact family and finite-field count, and clarifies that this branch is actually diagonal R=S, hence an ordinary relative Rota-Baxter operator in the source's own terminology.
